deviations: D1 NF4 4-bit weights (not bf16) for all four checkpoints; absolute accuracies are not comparable to bf16 model cards.
D2 250 frozen stratified items per task per language (not the full test sets); CIs resolve the 5-point sanity bar, not sub-point claims.

D3 In-house harness-replica scorer; validated on the ORIGINAL models against lm-eval 0.4.13 (EN tasks) and GaMS-Team tasks_sl@d05d470f run in the same harness (SL): rendered strings 100% identical, correct-flag agreement 98.7% (GaMS) / 99.5% (Gemma) -- the pre-registered |dll|<0.05 nats bar FAILS (median 0.10 GaMS / 0.13 Gemma) because lm-eval returns bf16-rounded log-likelihoods (e.g. -18.875) while the scorer is float32; treated as a numeric artefact, not a template error (see results/<m>/harness_validation.json).
D4 Readout gate operationalized as item AUROC>=0.85 and condition-level Spearman>=0.85 (16 cells).
D5 A2 x-axis = ORIGINAL-model frozen DiM score; post-edit-score and edit-subspace-projected variants are sensitivities.
D6 No human review; blinded 120-row EN/SL packet written and marked PENDING (results/native_review_packet_c1u.csv).

D7 Winsorization = per-vector symmetric q=0.995 (iteration-1 E3 recipe, parameter-free); the plan's per-dimension clip fitted on S3 half A is reported as a sensitivity (mech_<m>.json: sensitivity_perdim_clip).

D8 JUDGE BUDGET: the shared OpenRouter key was at its daily limit until 00:00 UTC and the run-level budget ($7 for this phase, shared with sibling artifacts) was exhausted at 00:04 UTC after 1,072 gpt-4.1 calls ($1.07 by this artifact). gpt-4.1 labels therefore cover a hash-ordered (effectively random) ~52% of S4 HARMFUL generations (118-150 per model x checkpoint x language) and no harmless/r_prior generations.

D9 Second judge = nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free (plan: gemini-2.5-flash; paid models blocked). It labels (i) a stratified 200 of the gpt-4.1-judged items for kappa, (ii) the r_prior generations, (iii) ~50 harmless generations per model x checkpoint (free-tier daily cap of 1,000 requests reached; H100 not completed); dose generations were NOT judged. Gate and judged A2 use gpt-4.1 labels where available else second-judge labels ('combined'); gpt-4.1-only gate reported alongside. Agreement with gpt-4.1: kappa 0.828 (refused vs not), 0.765 (6-way), n=200.
D10 S4 harmless generations were produced for all 257 twins at 128 tokens (superset of the planned H100); judge labels cover H100 only; rule-based validity covers all 257.
D11 Hardware changed between the interrupted and the resumed session (L4 -> RTX 4090, both sm_89); every paired orig-vs-edit quantity was computed within one session.

D12 Exploratory additions beyond the plan (not confirmatory): drift geometry (mech_extra.py), item-level flip analysis, edit-strength dose-response (dose.py), dose_judge.py prepared but not run (free-tier cap).
what_this_does_NOT_show: Two models x one Heretic run each: no claim about model families, training stages (continual pretraining / SFT / safety data) or optimizer variance; Gemma-IT is a same-size reference, not GaMS's parent.

Differences between the GaMS and Gemma edits mix intrinsic model properties with ACHIEVED optimisation: trial 88 (GaMS) ablates a layer-22 direction with weights >1 across almost all layers (KL 0.175 on Heretic's prompts); trial 96 (Gemma) ablates a layer-26 direction with down_proj weight decaying to ~0 within ~20 layers (KL 0.024).
Probe decodability (AUROC) is not causal use; the frozen/refit decomposition shows where information is linearly available, not that the model uses it.
S4 prompts are StrongREJECT + gpt-4.1 twins with MT Slovene (automated QC only, native review pending); RefusEU behaviour belongs to the behaviour artifact (only label-free S5/S5X projections here).
Judge labels: gpt-4.1 on a random half of harmful generations; a free second-family judge elsewhere; no human labels.
judge_coverage_note: gpt-4.1: 1,072 S4 harmful generations; second judge: 850 generations (200 kappa sample, 376 r_prior, ~200 harmless, rest harmful).
